reported.title: Bounce can start a second burst after release
reported.description: The settle logic only debounces the raw level, but `held` is updated only when the level is stable; on release bounce the level flips HIGH/LOW and after 20 ms of a stable HIGH, `held` becomes false, then a subsequent bounce LOW that settles 20 ms re-triggers openZone, starting a second burst. The 12 ms bounce spec requires a proper debounce that ignores transitions within the bounce window and only accepts a press after a stable LOW following a stable HIGH.

reported.title: Press during open can be accepted after close
reported.description: Because `held` is only cleared when the debounced level is HIGH, a press held through the burst keeps `held` true, but if the button is released and re-pressed during the burst, the release may not be registered before close, so a press during the open window can be accepted right after close, violating 'presses while open are ignored'.

judge_input.spec:
- Zone valve relay on D10; start button on D6 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- A settled press on D6 opens the valve (D10 HIGH) for 500 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 12 ms on press and release must not start a second burst.
- Presses while the valve is open are ignored and do not extend it.
- The valve stays closed (D10 LOW) whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `zone n=<count>` every 1000 ms.
